apple.priceEvidence: Actual saved initial/current price dialogs, not the available-price matrix or local StoreKit catalog
apple.territoryEvidence: Monthly subscription and all tip product pages show exactly one territory selected; exact territory not independently opened this turn. Japan is the approved target; do not interpret 175 price rows as sale availability.

storage.caveat: Metadata-only aggregate for one project, not proof of physical absence, organization-wide usage, writer coverage, future capacity or a retention SLA.

remaining: Signed Apple Sandbox lifecycle and delivered premium benefits
Operationally isolated account deletion with family/other apps preserved
Whole-server storage allocation, reservation/admission, retention and service-exit policy
Final public legal text and accurate App Store data declarations
Physical device/VoiceOver/full-screen checks and final signed build
Final listing screenshots, review credentials/contact and product review evidence
